text:
pat_lead: Heads-up  we need three design partners for a tightly-scoped Private + Dedicated pilot. Main deliverables: verify the onboarding signal contract (traces, cost logs), prove KMS handoff, and validate the rollback/health gating knobs. Shortlist by Thu.

mina_eng: I can own the small SDK + quickstart that emits the signal contract. Will include a tiny client that tags traces with partner-id and route-path. ETA Wed.

pat_lead: Incentives thought: $7k credits + 10 weeks of priority Dedicated + an engineering retro + optional co-marketing blurb. Also offer a one-page runbook we co-author. Sound fair?

jorge_ops: Ops: we'll need a single page infra form from partners (network option, IPs, KMS vendor, on-call contact). I can handle two peering setups; third will probably be VPN. Also propose a 48h emergency rollback SLA in the MOU.

tara_research: Proposed acceptance/checklist (we'll publish in outreach):
- Observability: partner can send traces or allow us to ingest sampled traces and token-cost data (min fields: trace_id, route_path, latency_ms, token_count, model).
- Performance: p95 target (we'll specify ms after prompt set is locked).
- Resilience: fallback completion rate >= 99% over pilot window.
- Integration: onboarding effort <= 3 dev-days to reach baseline route.
- Business: partner commits to weekly short check-ins and provides product contact for go/no-go.
These determine pass/fail for expanding the program.

ben_sales: Screening email checklist draft: 1) Typical QPS and avg token length? 2) Data residency needs? 3) KMS provider + ability to share a test key? 4) Which network option (peering/VPN/hosted-edge)? 5) Who signs the MOU internally? 6) Can you share one representative prompt + expected answer?

pat_lead: Add: "Are you willing to let us run nightly automated evals against a canned dataset?" and "Do you need a nondisclosure extension beyond our DP NDA?"

mina_eng: Quickstart will include this lightweight curl to exercise routing and emit the minimal signal contract:```
curl -X POST https://private.redwood.redwood/v1/run \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DP_KEY' \
  -H 'x-partner-id: acme-inc' \
  -H 'x-trace-sample: true' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-dedicated-1","input":"trigger routing","timeout_ms":900}'
```
Response includes a header X-Route-Path and we'll log trace events with route and fallback flags.

jorge_ops: Pre-Dedicated infra checklist (short): IP allowlist, VPN creds or peering setup, KMS test key, on-call pager contact, signed MOU. I'll post a template. Also note: if partner cannot send traces, require a CSV export with equivalent columns.

tara_research: Eval plan: 10 prompts across three families (chat, extraction, short-code). I'll produce the set and an automated runner. We'll require partners to accept nightly runs against a canned dataset or provide a local runner.

legal-bot: Updated DP NDA v2026-06-01 is available at https://redwood.docs/nda-dp. Use "Design Partner" variant and attach the MOU template.

ben_sales: Outreach flow: short intro + MOU + NDA link -> 30m technical discovery -> onboarding checklist -> week2 health check -> week8 wrap. I'll draft the outreach copy and owner spreadsheet.

mina_eng: Observability export: we'll produce a minimal JSONL schema for trace events and a small script to POST to our ingest endpoint; partners can either forward events or S3 drop. Schema fields: trace_id, partner_id, route_path, latency_ms, token_count, model, fallback_flag.

jorge_ops: Rollback gating: propose auto-split to hosted (80/20) if p95 exceeds threshold for >10m; full rollback if >30m. MOU includes an emergency rollback window and contact method.

tara_research: Success to graduate pilot: at least 2 partners satisfy observability + perf SLOs and integration dev-effort <=72 hours, and product contact signs off. If not met, extend pilot and iterate on SDK/infra.

pat_lead: Owners: @ben_sales outreach, @mina_eng SDK + signals, @jorge_ops infra + runbook, @tara_research metrics + prompts. Deadline: shortlist Thu, invites Fri AM. Please update the shared spreadsheet when you claim an item. Keep replies short. Thanks!
